title: Archit II
medium: Dichroic, leaded, and non-leaded glasses with applied graphics

said.q: The smallest of the three Archit pieces in this collection, Archit II carries the same cool palette of blues, whites, and soft purple as its companions, built up in Sand's signature interlocking planes. Built from leaded, non-leaded, and dichroic glass, the piece spins on its anodized aluminum base, balancing geometric structure with the fluid, ever-shifting color that only dichroic glass can produce, a hallmark of Sand's forty-plus years working the medium.

events.n: received directly from the artist's studio
